articles.title: Oman, Iran discuss safeguarding maritime corridors, as attacks in Hormuz increase
articles.description: DUBAI, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Oman and Iran discussed safeguarding maritime corridors and ensuring the smooth flow of global shipping and trade, the Omani foreign ministry said in a statement on Tuesday, as shipping through the Strait of Hormuz continued to be disrupted.The talks took place during a visit by Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi to Oman, which holds the southern coast of the Strait of Hormuz, a key shipping route for global energy, and has played a role as mediator in the crisis that broke out when the US and Israel attacked Iran on February 28.

articles.title: Oman, Iran foreign ministers discuss safeguarding maritime corridors
articles.description: DUBAI, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Oman and Iran discussed on Tuesday safeguarding maritime corridors and ensuring the smooth flow of global shipping and trade, as well as revitalising channels for dialogue and negotiations to prevent escalations, the Omani foreign ministry said in a statement.The talks took place during a visit by Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi to Oman, which holds the southern coast of the Strait of Hormuz and has played a role as mediator in the crisis that broke out when the United States Israel and struck the Islamic Republic on February 28.
